tools.name: get_inflation
tools.description: Annual inflation rate (HICP, Eurostat) of one European country, the euro area or the EU in one month, with core, energy, food and services inflation for the same month. Without a month it returns the latest published month and says whether that figure is still a flash estimate. Monthly, up to 20 yea

tools.name: get_ecb_rates
tools.description: The European Central Bank's three key interest rates (deposit facility, main refinancing operations, marginal lending facility) with the date each took effect and the previous rate, plus the forward rates the AAA euro-area government bond curve implies for 3 months to 2 years ahead.

tools.name: get_wages
tools.description: The national statutory minimum wage (gross, euro per month, the rate in force on 1 January or 1 July) and the average full-time adjusted gross annual salary of one European country, from Eurostat. Says so when a country has no statutory minimum wage.

tools.name: get_fuel_prices
tools.description: The latest weekly consumer pump price of petrol (Euro-super 95) and diesel in one EU country, in euro per litre including taxes, from the European Commission's Weekly Oil Bulletin: the change on the previous week and on a year earlier, the price in the national currency for countries outside the eur

tools.name: get_electricity_spot_prices
tools.description: Day-ahead wholesale electricity prices for a Danish or Swedish bidding zone (DK1, DK2, SE3, SE4) for today or tomorrow: the day's average, the lowest and highest interval, the price now and the hourly averages, in euro per MWh and in the local currency per kWh. Before VAT, tax and grid fees. Data: E
